answer: Resist sybils with a basalt vault and a spiral bond staircase. Each cohort pours its members' bonds into one basalt vault that cannot be split until the cohort dissolves, so a clone ring cannot isolate its losses. Joining as the k-th member costs a bond of base times k: one honest agent pays base, while N clones pay roughly N squared over two in total. If any member cheats, the vault slashes every bond and drops the whole cohort to the nadir rung, erasing all its accumulated influence. Clones must re-climb from zero with fresh bonds, while a lone honest agent risks only base.
